outcomes.name: Surging Inspiration
outcomes.text:
Both players start with
upgraded Hero Powers.

outcomes.name: Uncontrollable Growth
outcomes.text: Both players start with an extra Mana Crystal.

outcomes.name: Approaching Nightmare
outcomes.text:
Both players start with
Yogg-Saron, Hope's End
in their hand.

outcomes.name: Driven to Excess
outcomes.text: Whenever a player ends their turn with unspent Mana, they draw a card.

outcomes.name: Driven to Greed
outcomes.text: Whenever a player ends their turn with unspent Mana, they get a Coin.

outcomes.name: Twist Reality
outcomes.text:
[x]The first time a player
plays a card on their
turn, shuffle a copy of
it into their deck.

outcomes.name: Seeing Double
outcomes.text:
Both players start with
2 cards copied from the other player's hand.

outcomes.name: Fortifications
outcomes.text: At the end of each players' turns, give a random one of their minions +1 Health.

outcomes.name: Fast Track
outcomes.text: Reduce the Cost of all cards in both player's starting hands by (1).

outcomes.name: Shifting Futures
outcomes.text: Both players start with 2 copies of Shifter Zerus in their hand.

outcomes.name: Control the Makers
outcomes.text: Both heroes have +1 Attack on their turns.

outcomes.name: Army of the Corrupted
outcomes.text: The first minion played on each player's turns costs (1) less.

outcomes.name: Opportunity Knocks
outcomes.text: The first card drawn on a player's turn is one they can afford to play.

outcomes.name: Spread of Corruption
outcomes.text: The first spell cast on each player's turns costs (1) less.

outcomes.name: Gift of Gluttony
outcomes.text: Both players start with two more drawn cards.

outcomes.name: Shifting Fate
outcomes.text:
[x]Both players start with
Gear Shift in their hand.

outcomes.name: Light in the Dark
outcomes.text: Both players' Hero Powers cost (1) less.
